title: Sex Addiction Recovery
cardText: For those caught in compulsive sexual behavior or pornography use who are ready to stop living a double life.
whatThisFeelsLike: You've promised yourself it was the last time more times than you can count. The shame is constant, the secrecy is exhausting, and you're afraid of what honesty would cost.
howWeWork: Recovery work here starts from a simple stance: you are not disgusting, and you are not beyond help. Using CBT, sessions map the cycle — the triggers, the rituals, the aftermath — and build honest, workable ways to interrupt it. Where relationships have been damaged, EFT supports rebuilding trust at a pace that respects everyone involved. Everything you share stays confidential within the standard legal limits of licensed counseling.
